THE ALBERT HALL MANSION
Albert Hall Mansions History
Albert Hall Mansions, nestled in the heart of London, is an iconic residential complex with a rich Victorian heritage. Designed by renowned architect Richard Norman Shaw, construction began in 1879 and concluded in 1886, marking a milestone in London’s architectural evolution. Among the city’s first luxury apartments, it catered to Victorian elites. Its red-brick façade, ornate terracotta details, and grand gables epitomize the Queen Anne revival style. Home to notable figures over the years, it remains a symbol of prestige and timeless elegance.
A Prestigious Address
The Albert Hall Mansion is situated in one of London’s most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic and architecturally significant building offers residents breathtaking views as well as an exclusive address. The location provides the perfect balance between the vibrant energy of city life and the tranquility of a refined residential area.
Location
Albert Hall Mansions is ideally located in one of London's most prestigious neighborhoods, directly overlooking the iconic Royal Albert Hall. This historic building offers breathtaking views and an exclusive address, balancing the vibrant energy of city life with the tranquility of a refined residential area. Situated in South Kensington, residents have access to Hyde Park, the Victoria and Albert Museum, and the luxury shopping of Knightsbridge, along with an array of fine dining, shopping, and cultural attractions. This location is perfect for those seeking a sophisticated and dynamic lifestyle.

Jeddah is one of Saudi Arabia's largest and most active real estate markets, driven by its status as a commercial hub and gateway city on the Red Sea coast. Demand for residential property in Jeddah is supported by a growing population, ongoing infrastructure investment, and ambitious national development plans under Saudi Vision 2030. Collaborating with iconic brands to deliver iconic living experiences
Marriott International Residences
Welcome Home
Rooted in hospitality, Marriott Residences offer the kinds of thoughtful, innovative amenities that cater to your elevated lifestyle. In collaboration with DarGlobal, a new kind of home was crafted, one that ensures owners wake up every day to the same wonderful experiences that they have come to expect from Marriott Hotels, and truly understands the wants and needs of the discerning few who enjoy luxury living.
Discover More
Pagani
Living The Dream
Horacio Pagani always dreamed of creating the most beautiful car in the world. Not only did he succeed, but also, he created a whole new dimension in the automotive field, a dimension only the few can aspire to After years of perfecting his automotive masterpiece, Horacio Pagani partnered with DarGlobal to pay tribute to his muse, Leonardo DaVinci, by blending beauty and function to give life to the first residences in the world with interiors by Pagani.
Missoni
“ To furnish my own way is to create an organized but informal habitat that excites and intrigues, where every space is an oasis of colors and moods.” – Rosita Missoni, founder of Missoni. After designing the iconic Missoni Baia in Miami, Florida, Missoni partnered with DarGlobal to, for the second time ever, export its distinct living concept to Dubai. An iconic residential tower in Dubai decorated with a range of exquisite home accessories and colorful settings, presenting Missoni’s take on elite ‘Miami lifestyle’ homes on par with luxury and fashion.
W Hotels
A vibrant Lifestyle
Born out of the bold attitude and 24/7 culture of New York City, W Hotels has defied expectations, broken down all the norms of traditional luxury, and taken it to the next level. They partnered with DarGlobal to design its ultra-exquisite W Residences Dubai – Downtown, situated in the beating heart of Dubai’s vibrant life.

ELIE SAAB founded his eponymous label in 1982, at just 18 years old. He partnered with DarGlobal to create Qatar’s ﬁrst ever co-branded residences on Qetaifan Island North.
Dolce and Gabbana
The Allure of Italian Fashion
Dolce&Gabbana is an Italian luxury fashion house founded in 1985 by Italian designers Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana. The house quickly overtook the world with its avantgarde designs in haute Couture, ready-to-wear, handbags, accessories, cosmetics and furnishings. In partnership with DarGlobal, this Italian allure will come to life in one of the most beautiful places in the world, the Maldives. The partnership’s debut project is set to be a game-changer in the luxury hospitality industry, combining Dolce&Gabbana’s unparalleled sense of style with DarGlobal’s unrivalled attention to detail and commitment to excellence.
Trump Organization
Setting the Standards of Excellence
In New York City and around the world, the Trump signature is synonymous with the most prestigious of addresses. In collaboration with DarGlobal, the Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course will be developed on the hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman.

A New Era of Elegance
DarGlobal and Aston Martin unite to redefine luxury living with a groundbreaking residential development. This prestigious collaboration marks the first time Aston Martin ventures into the GCC, bringing its iconic elegance and cutting-edge innovation to the region. Known for their exquisite craftsmanship and timeless design, Aston Martin's involvement ensures a living experience that epitomizes sophistication and luxury. By combining their automotive heritage with architectural prowess, this partnership promises to deliver unparalleled excellence in a prime location, setting a new standard for luxury living.

MUSCAT OMAN
MUSCAT, OMAN
Oman’s capital city is coveted by global citizens and smart investors alike. That’s because it offers that rare balance of lifestyle and potential. A strategic location with a scenic coastline. A rich history and a future-facing economy. A popular travel destination that offers lifetime residency for buyers. DarGlobal is shaping its next chapter, with refined residences in Muscat’s most desirable settings.
Strategic Location
Oman is strategically located on the south-eastern coast of the Arabian Peninsula, serving as a gateway between Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. Its capital, Muscat, just 60 minutes by flight from Dubai, plays a crucial role in regional trade and commerce. Oman’s access to key shipping routes positions it well for economic growth and international collaboration.
GDP Growth
As of 2024, Oman’s GDP was 41.12 billion OMR ($106.94 billion USD), with an estimated increase in growth rate of 2.6% from 2024 to 2029. The diversification strategy, Vision 2040, aims to reduce oil dependency and increase the contribution of non-oil sectors to the GDP.
Investment Climate
The government has been actively encouraging foreign investment through various incentives and relaxed regulations. The establishment of free zones and special economic zones, such as Duqm, provides attractive opportunities for investors.
Unlock Exclusive Residency
Foreign nationals can obtain a residency visa by investing in real estate within Integrated Tourism Complexes (ITC) in Oman. The validity of the Resident Visa is 2 years, renewable.

Nomination Committee
The Nomination Committee assists the Board in discharging its responsibilities relating to the composition and make-up of the Board and any committees of the Board. It is also responsible for periodically reviewing the Board’s structure and composition and identifying potential candidates to be appointed as directors or committee members as the need may arise. The Nomination Committee is responsible for evaluating the balance of skills, knowledge and experience and the size, structure and composition of the Board and committees of the Board, and retirements and appointments of additional and replacement directors and committee members, and will make appropriate recommendations to the Board on such matters. The Nomination Committee will be chaired by David Weinreb and its other members will be Richard Stockdale and Maurice Horan.
Remuneration Committee
The Remuneration Committee assists the Board in determining its responsibilities in relation to directors’ remuneration, including making recommendations to the Board on the Company’s policy on executive remuneration, including setting the over-arching principles, parameters and governance framework of the Group’s remuneration policy and determining the individual remuneration and benefits package of each of the Executive Directors and senior management (including fees paid to the Company Secretary). The Remuneration Committee will give due regard to the provisions and recommendations in the Corporate Governance Code when determining the remuneration policy. The Remuneration Committee will be chaired by Richard Stockdale and its other members will be David Weinreb and Maurice Horan.
Audit And Risk Committee

[DarGlobal | Investor relations | Board Of Directors]
The Audit and Risk Committee assists the Board in discharging its responsibilities with regard to financial reporting, external and internal audits and controls, including reviewing and monitoring the integrity of the Group’s annual and interim financial statements, reviewing and monitoring the extent of the non-audit work undertaken by external auditors, advising on the appointment of external auditors, overseeing the Group’s relationship with its external auditors, reviewing the effectiveness of the external audit process, and reviewing the effectiveness of the Group’s internal audit, internal controls, risk management, whistleblowing and anti fraud systems. The ultimate responsibility for reviewing and approving the annual report and accounts and the half-yearly reports remains with the Board. section: Frequently Asked Questions - The Astera by Aston Martin
text:
[DarGlobal | Partner: Aston Martin | Frequently Asked Questions - The Astera by Aston Martin]
Frequently Asked Questions - The Astera by Aston Martin
Who developed The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin?
The Astera is developed by DarGlobal in partnership with Aston Martin, marking the British marque's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council).
Where is The Astera located?
The Astera sits on Al Marjan Island in Ras Al Khaimah, UAE, near the Wynn Resort with direct beachfront access, about an hour's drive from Dubai.
What types of residences are available at The Astera?
The development offers one, two and three-bedroom apartments alongside three-bedroom villas, each finished with Aston Martin's signature interior design.
Is this Aston Martin's first real estate project in the Middle East?
Yes. The Astera marks Aston Martin's first real estate collaboration in the GCC (Gulf Cooperation Council), following earlier design partnerships in the United States and Japan.
What is the value of The Astera development?
The Astera carries a Gross Development Value of approximately AED 900 million, around £200 million.
When is The Astera expected to be completed?
Construction is underway following the appointment of Stromek Emirates Foundations for shoring, excavation and piling works, with completion due by December 2028.
What amenities does The Astera offer?
Residents have access to a private beach, an infinity pool with ocean views, a scenic walking track, an indoor cinema, a fitness centre, a spa, a yoga lawn, a children's play area and a multipurpose hall.
What makes the Aston Martin interiors distinct?
Aston Martin's design team applies the marque's signature blend of sophistication, precision craftsmanship and high-performance design language to every residence's interior.
How far is The Astera from Dubai?
Dubai is approximately an hour's drive from Al Marjan Island, keeping The Astera close to the city while offering a secluded beachfront setting.
Can international buyers obtain UAE residency by purchasing at The Astera?
Buyers investing AED 2 million or more qualify for the UAE's 10-year Golden Visa, and the UAE applies 0% income tax and 0% property tax.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
section: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text:
[News | 2026-09-30 | press]
Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, recently announced its unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (HY 2026), reporting a 66% revenue increase to US$258.0 million (HY 2025: US$155.4 million).
The performance was driven by the Group’s projects and sustained demand across its diversified portfolio in the GCC, Europe, and the UK.
Gross profit for the period rose 85% to US$87.7 million, expanding margins to 34% (from 31%).
EBITDA increased 73% to US$46.3 million, while net profit surged 149% to US$30.4 million (HY 2025: US$12.2 million).
Growth was primarily anchored by revenue recognition from landmark projects, including The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin and Neptune, Interiors by Mouawad.
The Group’s Gross Development Value (GDV) nearly doubled year-on-year to reach US$23.0 billion, reflecting rapid portfolio expansion.
Cumulative contracted sales rose to US$3.9 billion across 4,380 units.
Dar Global maintained a robust balance sheet with a Net Asset Value of US$613.3 million and total cash balances of US$847.9 million (comprising US$231.6 million free cash and US$616.3 million restricted escrow), supporting total available liquidity of US$579.3 million.
Operational momentum accelerated in Saudi Arabia with major project launches.
In January, the Group partnered with The Trump Organization to launch Rayana, a 2.6 million sq.
m gated community in Diriyah featuring luxury mansions and a championship golf course, followed by a SAR 338 million (~US$90 million) infrastructure contract award to Compass and Bin Omairah Company.

title: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
section: Dar Global delivers 66% revenue growth in HY 2026 as portfolio GDV reaches $23bln
text:

Dar Global also unveiled Trump Plaza Jeddah (GDV US$383.6 million) and the adjacent Padel Living Residences (GDV US$142 million) within the Amaya masterplan.
Capital management and project execution remained key focus areas.
In April, the Group strengthened its financial flexibility by closing a US$250 million syndicated term loan facility.
Following the period in August, Dar Global appointed Gulf Asia Contracting to execute podium construction for the 80-storey, ~350-metre Trump International Hotel & Tower on Dubai's Sheikh Zayed Road.
Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive, commented: “We have delivered a resilient performance through uncertain times in the region, supported by the quality of our international portfolio.
Buyer demand across our markets remained robust, with cumulative contracted sales at 30 June 2026 of c.
US$3.9 billion (Dec 2025 c.

Ziad El Chaar, Chief Executive Officer of DarGlobal, said: "Over the last five years, we have built a company designed for global citizens, investors who increasingly live, work and invest across multiple countries.
What began as a luxury real estate developer has evolved into a diversified platform spanning real estate, hospitality, golf, private clubs, asset management and emerging real estate technologies, developed alongside some of the world's most recognised brands.

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
section: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text:
[News | 2026-01-21 | blog]
The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
How Rail Is Reshaping the Region Into One Connected Market of Opportunity In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day.
After 13:15, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors and take the keys with him.
Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M — an extraordinary leap in one generation.
But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.
The Trains Are Coming One rail announcement after another is transforming six separate markets into one connected region: - Riyadh–Doha high-speed rail ~2 hours of travel, 10M+ passengers expected, 30K new jobs, ~$30B in economic impact.
- UAE domestic rail (Etihad Rail) Linking 11 cities as of 2026.
Abu Dhabi to Dubai in 57 minutes, with a future high-speed train cutting that to 30 minutes.
- UAE–Oman corridor (Hafeet Rail) Connecting Abu Dhabi to Sohar in ~100 minutes, transforming both passenger movement and freight.
All of this feeds into the 2,100 km GCC Railway, which by 2030 aims to create a single passenger experience that feels like domestic travel.
What This Means for People & Business When borders become this frictionless, behavior changes.
Millions of air passengers now have tempting alternatives.
Tourism spreads - Dubai residents can finish work on Friday and enjoy dinner in Muscat.
- Families in Doha see Riyadh as a two-hour weekend trip.
- Standalone trips evolve into multi-city Gulf experiences.
Business accelerates - Morning meetings in Riyadh, back in Abu Dhabi by afternoon.
- Supply chains reorganize around rail hubs.
